violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -In-use utensils for food service stored on dry clothes between uses. -Ice scoop in the bar area is being stored on dry clothe between uses.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Both metal stand-up freezers need cleaned out.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Multiple ceiling tiles need replaced over food prep areas.
